description.zh: 配合**SortingField**参数一起使用，**true**表示升序，**false**表示降序。
description.en: Used together with the **SortingField** parameter. A value of **true** indicates ascending order, and a value of **false** indicates descending order.
The DevEUI of the node for fuzzy matching.

description.zh: 本次查询的节点数量上限，大于等于1。
description.en: The maximum number of nodes to return in this query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.
The ID of the node group.

description.zh: 本次查询的起始位置，从0开始。
description.en: The start position of this query, starting from 0.

description.zh: 指定排序字段，可取值为**CREATED_MILLIS**，表示根据创建时间排序。
description.en: The sorting field. Valid value: **CREATED_MILLIS**, which indicates sorting by creation time.

title.zh: 查询指定节点分组中的节点列表
title.en: Query the List of Nodes in a Specified Node Group
